workload: 2s stereo FLAC to32000,44100,48000Hz f32 outputs; three persistent consumers of canonical48kHz PCM
baseline: Three concurrent independent FFmpeg decode/resample jobs
candidate: One decoder plus three FFmpeg PCM resampler jobs with2x4096byte queues; blocking backpressure for active consumers
correctness: Complete exact PCM at all rates against independent baseline; actual stopped slow consumer must not contaminate survivors; terminate source1 midstream and restart with distinct source2, reject stale source1 publish into new queues, reap every owned process/thread
sampling: Correctness/lifecycle first, one warmup pair plus5 alternating measured pairs on source1; include all process/thread start, reads/writes, queue copies, EOF and joins; source fixture generation excluded but job setup included
threshold: Candidate complete wall median<=0.9baseline while no queue exceeds8192bytes; output identity mandatory
excluded: Opaque FFmpeg pipe/process memory, physical energy, browser/integration
